query:
WITH removed AS (
			DELETE FROM technical_review_queue
			WHERE project_id = ANY($1::bigint[])
			RETURNING project_id
		)
		SELECT removed.project_id AS "project_id!: DBProjectId",
			(
				SELECT thread.id
				FROM threads thread
				WHERE thread.mod_id = removed.project_id
				ORDER BY thread.id
				LIMIT 1
			) AS "thread_id!: DBThreadId"
		FROM removed
